name: David Trone
bio: a Representative from Maryland; born in Cheverly, Prince George's County, Md., September 21, 1955; B.A., Furman University, Greenville, S.C., 1977; M.B.A., University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, Pa., 1985; entrepreneur; business owner; unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the One Hundred Fifteenth Congress in 2016; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Sixteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2019-January 3, 2025); was not a candidate for reelection to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress in 2024, but was an unsuccessful candidate for nomination to the United States Senate.
